criterion: which assistant-command intent the utterance expresses, that is what the user wants done

categories.name: Set Alarm
categories.definition: Requests to set an alarm for a specific time or recurring schedule.

categories.name: Manage Alarm
categories.definition: Requests to modify, cancel, or snooze existing alarms.

categories.name: Set Timer
categories.definition: Requests to set a timer for a specific duration.

categories.name: Manage Timer
categories.definition: Requests to modify, cancel, or check existing timers.

categories.name: Set Reminder
categories.definition: Requests to set a reminder for a specific task or event.

categories.name: Manage Reminder
categories.definition: Requests to modify, cancel, or check existing reminders.

categories.name: Weather Inquiry
categories.definition: Requests for current or forecasted weather information.

categories.name: News Inquiry
categories.definition: Requests for current news updates or specific news topics.

categories.name: Music Control
categories.definition: Requests to play, pause, skip, or repeat music tracks.

categories.name: Music Inquiry
categories.definition: Requests for information about currently playing or specific songs.

categories.name: Music Provider Management
categories.definition: Requests to change or set default music providers.

categories.name: Call Initiation
categories.definition: Requests to start a phone or video call with specific contacts.

categories.name: Call Management
categories.definition: Requests to end, join, or manage ongoing calls.

categories.name: Messaging
categories.definition: Requests to send, read, or reply to messages.

categories.name: Social Inquiry
categories.definition: Requests for information about friends or social connections.

categories.name: Recipe Inquiry
categories.definition: Requests for recipes or cooking instructions.

categories.name: General Inquiry
categories.definition: Requests for general information or facts not covered by other categories.
